title: JuControler project status projection
description: A read-only projection of source-owned project status. The source owns status; JuControler owns only projection metadata and must not mutate or infer source state.

schema.description: Projection contract identifier; owned by the contract, not the source.

projectId.description: Stable project identifier owned by the project repository/source.

status.description: Opaque source-reported status. UNKNOWN is required when the source is missing, invalid, ambiguous, or contradictory; consumers must preserve unrecognized values.

observedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 time when the source observed status; source-owned evidence, not projection generation time.

generatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 time when this read-only projection was generated.

stale.description: Whether the source observation exceeds its freshness limit; does not change or infer status.

kind.description: Source kind whose owner defines status vocabulary and freshness rules.

id.description: Stable canonical source identifier; credentials and private payloads are not permitted.

source.description: Canonical source authority for status; reads are allowed, writes and command dispatch are not.

sourceRevision.description: Optional source-owned revision, release, or snapshot identifier.

reason.description: Optional bounded machine-readable reason for UNKNOWN or stale; must not invent status.
